name: Spinner
description:
The Spinner component displays an indeterminate loading indicator: an animated `<svg>` that inherits the current text color. It is typically used in buttons, dialogs, and other components with a loading state.

The root renders with `role="status"` and `aria-busy="true"`. Set `size` for its width and height; without it the spinner fills its container's width.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction rendering the animated spinner artwork in `Spinner.Root`, sized with `size`

props.name: size
props.description: The width and height of the spinner, set as the `<svg>` attributes. Without it the spinner fills its container's width.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Spinner component.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
